text: The town should host the autumn food festival. The vendor association submitted a comprehensive crowd management plan that clearly outlines measures to ensure the festival runs smoothly and safely. Additionally, the proposed night market format, although untested in the county, has been successfully tried in other towns and has a surplus of profit. Furthermore, the proposed format for the fair has been profitable in the same location for five years, demonstrating its potential for success. Overall, these factors make the autumn food festival a highly viable and innovative idea for the town.
